chunks: From him, from his father, he said:
ai.seo_question: What is the health benefit of frequent combing according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) underscores the Prophetic tradition of *Tibb al-Nabawi* (Prophetic Medicine), linking physical grooming to physiological health. It reflects the Shia scholarly view that the Imams provided holistic guidance, where spiritual discipline and bodily hygiene are intertwined to maintain both inner purity and external well-being.
